title: Celebrate All Elements When Introduction Finishes
description: Once the introduction is finished all the ui elements should show the celebration effect.
summary: When the introduction completes (Done on the last step, or finishing the last interaction-gated step), every mounted UI element now shows the celebration ring. Added celebrateAllElements() which stamps data-celebrated on all valid element ids/aliases (skipping ui.introduction.* chrome). Wired via dismissIntroduction(completed) — completed=true celebrates all; Skip/Escape does not. Per-step celebration of introduce/interaction targets is unchanged.
